home.heroTitle: Reliable car care at locked prices in Cairo

uncertainty.outcomeUnknownDesc: Network or connection was interrupted before receiving server confirmation. To protect data integrity and avoid duplicate operations, this action is in an unconfirmed state. Inputs are preserved. Re-check server status before taking further action.
uncertainty.stillUnconfirmed: The server record has not changed or is not yet visible. An in-flight operation may still be processing or committed later. Retry remains disabled to prevent duplicate actions. Please continue re-checking, or reconcile manually via the Operations queue or system logs.
uncertainty.manualReconciliationPath: Manual Reconciliation Path: If the server status remains unchanged after repeated re-checks, inspect the audit trail or contact Operations before re-submitting.
uncertainty.reconciledStateNotice: Server state reconciled with current database record (Status: {status}, Version: {version}).
uncertainty.reconciledDifferentNotice: Notice: The server state reflects changes by another update or user. Please review the updated record.
uncertainty.readBackFailed: Could not connect to the server to verify status. Please check your connection and re-check again.

staffOffers.catalogIntro: Operations defines eligible services; Sales selects them for fixed-scope offers.
staffOffers.offersIntro: Provider activation and offer approval do not publish an offer. Customer visibility depends on a separate Operations command and current eligibility.
staffOffers.pendingIntro: Review the evidenced price, scope, and provider consent before deciding.
staffOffers.packetHelp: Enter the opaque reference from the controlled evidence repository. This app does not upload or retrieve the file.
staffOffers.attestPrice: I verified the normal and customer prices
staffOffers.attestScope: I verified the bilingual service scope
staffOffers.attestConsent: I verified provider consent and commercial terms
staffOffers.internalOnly: Internal approval only — customer visibility requires a separate Operations publication command.
staffOffers.approved: Internal approval confirmed by the server.
staffOffers.unknown: The response was lost or the server failed after dispatch. Outcome is unknown; do not start another intent.
staffOffers.manual: Still unresolved. Contact Operations to inspect the audit trail before starting a new request.
staffOffers.conflict: This record changed. Review the current server state before taking a new action.
staffOffers.denied: You do not have permission to access this record or action.
staffOffers.missing: Record not found or not accessible.
staffOffers.genericError: The action could not be confirmed. Check the current state.
staffOffers.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot preserve the request ID. No request was sent. Enable session storage before retrying.
staffOffers.moneyInvalid: Enter EGP with at most two decimal places.
staffOffers.priceInvalid: The customer price must be positive and below the evidenced normal price.
staffOffers.dateInvalid: Enter an unambiguous Cairo date and time.
staffOffers.evidenceMissing: A price evidence packet reference is required before saving or submitting.
staffOffers.repositoryUnavailable: Approval is blocked until the controlled evidence repository is ready. The draft remains available.
staffOffers.publicationExplanation: Internal approval alone does not publish. A separate Operations command pins one approved revision. No booking or purchase is available in this release.
staffOffers.publicationVisible: Yes, subject to recheck on each request
staffOffers.publicationMayHideAgain: A provider, branch, catalog, validity, or deployment change can hide an active publication on the next public read. Withdraw to durably remove it.
staffOffers.publicationConfirmPublish: Publish the selected approved revision. This is a separate action from internal approval.
staffOffers.publicationConfirmReplace: Replace the currently pinned revision with the selected approved revision. Earlier public terms are not changed until this command commits.
staffOffers.publicationConfirmWithdraw: Withdraw the currently published offer. Internal approval and historical revisions remain unchanged.
staffOffers.publicationCommandRecorded: The command is recorded. Current publication state was refreshed; verify effective visibility separately.
staffOffers.publicationCommandRejected: The command was rejected. Review the current publication state before trying a new intent.
staffOffers.publicationStillUnknown: The command outcome is unknown. Recheck its record before an explicit retry of the same command; do not start another intent.
staffOffers.publicationOtherPending: Another publication command in this tab remains unresolved. Return to its offer and reconcile it first.
staffOffers.publicationOriginalActor: Sign in as the Operations account that started this command to reconcile or retry it.
staffOffers.publicationNoReceipt: No durable command record found. The original request may still be in flight; retry only this exact command.
staffOffers.publicationReasonUnavailable: Currently not visible; review the current server state.
staffOffers.publicationReasonGateDisabled: The deployment publication gate is disabled.
staffOffers.publicationReasonPilotUnset: No Cairo pilot cluster is configured.
staffOffers.publicationReasonEvidenceUnavailable: The controlled evidence repository is not ready.
staffOffers.publicationReasonRevisionUnapproved: The pinned revision is not internally approved.
staffOffers.publicationReasonBranchUnvetted: The branch has not passed vetting.
staffOffers.publicationReasonOutsidePilot: The branch is outside the active Cairo pilot cluster.
staffOffers.publicationReasonCategoryInactive: The service category is not active.
staffOffers.publicationReasonServiceChanged: The captured service identity no longer matches the active definition.
staffOffers.publicationReasonQuoteRequired: The service requires a quote, not a fixed-price offer.
staffOffers.publicationReasonNotYetValid: The offer validity has not started.
staffOffers.publicationReasonAttestationsIncomplete: The required approval attestations are incomplete.
